instruction: Write an XDP program that must dispatch packets via 'dev_route_table_04' rewriting to default gateway MAC when no route matches. On route hit, rewrite destination MAC to route gateway and XDP_TX; on route miss, rewrite destination MAC to default gateway 52:54:00:00:00:fe and forward with XDP_TX.
requirements: Define LPM key struct with __u32 prefixlen and __u32 data members
Verify Ethernet and IPv4 header bounds against data_end
On hit rewrite destination MAC to route MAC; on miss rewrite to default gateway 52:54:00:00:00:fe
Return XDP_TX for all routed IPv4 packets, XDP_PASS for non-IP
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration
